title: The Surprising Math of Shuffling Cards
description: Why a standard deck of cards has more possible arrangements than atoms on Earth, and how shuffling works.
character_reference: a young man with neatly combed blonde hair, wearing a crisp collared white shirt and a black waistcoat

scenes.narration: Take a brand new deck of fifty-two playing cards and give it a thorough, proper shuffle.
scenes.visual: close-up of hands sliding a fresh pack of playing cards out of its smooth paper tuck box on a dark green felt table

scenes.narration: Statistically speaking, the exact order of cards you are holding right now has likely never existed in human history before.
scenes.visual: a fan of playing cards spread wide across a polished wooden tabletop, dramatic side lighting casting long shadows

scenes.narration: That is because the number of possible combinations is fifty-two factorial, written as fifty-two with sixty-seven zeros after it.
scenes.visual: massive columns of glowing digits cascading down a dark screen like a waterfall of pure mathematics

scenes.narration: To put that in perspective, it is vastly greater than the total number of grains of sand on every beach on planet Earth.
scenes.visual: extreme close-up of fine golden sand grains glittering under bright sunlight with shallow focus

scenes.narration: Even if you shuffled a deck once every second since the beginning of the universe, you wouldn't have scratched the surface of all combinations.
scenes.visual: antique mechanical pocket watch ticking with its intricate gold gears and springs visible through the glass case

scenes.narration: In fact, it takes just seven standard riffle shuffles to thoroughly mix a deck into complete randomness.
scenes.visual: action shot of two halves of a card deck smoothly weaving together mid-air during a riffle shuffle

scenes.narration: Probability hides staggering complexity behind the simplest everyday actions.
scenes.visual: abstract visual of glowing particles swirling into a chaotic yet balanced vortex

scenes.narration: Follow along for more mind-blowing math facts every single day.
scenes.visual: a single glowing ace of spades card resting flat on a dark wooden surface with warm ambient lighting
